title: Quiver Retail outbound mini-experiment notes
content:
Quick context:
- Prospect: Quiver Retail (mid-market omni-channel retailer). 120 stores + e-commerce.
- Why target: heavy search/FAQ volume, known issues with search relevance and returns; cares about latency (customer chat on-site).
- Exp hypothesis: 10-20% reduction in support CPC if we improve search relevancy & on-site assistant reliability; big ROI in CS deflection and AOV lift from better product discovery.
- Risk: PCI/sensitive payments handling on checkout pages -> may push for Private deployment or strict data controls.

Recent intel (notes from LinkedIn + call):
- CTO = Jordan Alvarez (joined 2024 from fintech); interested in infra-level SLAs.
- Head of Product (search) = Laila Gomez; built old solr cluster, skeptical of embedding-based rerank without evals.
- Current stack: Elasticsearch 7.x, custom rerank lambda, Datadog for tracing, GCP (us-west2 primary).

Primary ask for pilot:
- 6-week pilot: product search rerank + assistant snippets on product pages (not checkout).
- Success metrics: +15% relevant CTR on result clicks OR 30% reduction in search-driven returns; latency 95p < 200ms for on-site widget.
- Scope: integrate embeddings for query understanding + reranker overlay, lightweight caching on prefix matches.

Outbound / email drafts (A/B):
- Subject A: Quick idea to cut search returns at Quiver Retail
- Subject B: A 6-week pilot to improve product discovery (no infra lift)

Email body (short):
Hey Laila —
I know search relevance is a top priority for teams with big catalogs. We ran a short pilot with a retailer that saw a 12% lift in add-to-cart after replacing a brittle keyword reranker with an embedding+rerank overlay.
Would you be open to a 20–30 minute call to model what that could look like for Quiver? We can scope a lightweight 6-week pilot that leaves checkout untouched and runs in your GCP project or our hosted environment depending on your risk posture.
—Maya

Call script / discovery checklist (quick):
- Confirm traffic profile: queries/sec peak/day, median query length, top 50 queries.
- Current infra: which GCP project, any private subnet constraints?
- Data flow: confirm product catalog export cadence (sync/nearline), whether PII exists in titles/descriptions.
- Acceptance criteria: who signs off on CTR vs returns? Marketing or Product?
- Integration acceptance: is there an existing rerank endpoint to call, or do we run a proxy layer?

Objection handling (brain dump):
- "We can't send product data off-prem / to hosted API" -> Response: propose Redwood Private (VPC peering) or dedicated with customer-side KMS; pilot can run in their GCP project (we provide deployment terraform + support).
- "Embedding rerank is a black box; metrics might be worse" -> Response: propose fixed seed eval suite (we'll run A/B on a held-out queryset), show recall/precision and error cases, rollback policy and canary threshold.
- "Latency concerns for live search" -> Response: recommend model variant with quantized weights, enforce per-request fast-path (local KV cache + short-circuit for exact matches); propose SLOs and trace hook in Redwood Console for token-level latency breakdown.
- "Cost worries" -> Response: show batching + prefix caching plan reduces per-token cost; give two pricing scenarios (hosted pay-as-you-go vs short-term dedicated commit). Include estimated cost range per million queries.

Integration notes (engineering asks to prepare before pilot):
- Need product catalog feed (CSV/JSON) sample: include category, title, description, price, product_id.
- Provide sample of top 500 queries from last 90 days.
- Confirm whether Elasticsearch rewrite rules exist (we will layer rerank; if they rely on function_score we need to map weights).
- SRE ask: who will configure DNS for a proxy if we do in-project deployment? Who can approve firewall rules?

Internal checklist (to run before outreach):
- [ ] Create short evaluation harness (10k queries) with current ES ranking baseline. (owner: Arjun)
- [ ] Produce brief cost model for both hosted & dedicated (owner: Maya)
- [ ] Health-check playbook for rollback/canary (owner: Sofia)
- [ ] Draft legal sample NDAs for pilot (legal reqs: data residency + KMS terms)

Pricing sketch (very rough):
- Hosted pilot: estimated $4k–7k for 6 weeks (metered inference + onboarding).
- Dedicated (short commit): $8k/month minimum (comes with reserved latency band + higher throughput).
- Private (on-prem/VPC): one-time setup + support retainer, estimate kickoff $20k+ depending on infra complexity.

Next steps / outreach plan:
- Email Laila + cc Jordan (intro) — target send date next Tue.
- If no reply in 4 days, follow-up with short case study + 2 concrete times.
- Goal: get discovery call within two weeks of first email.

Notes-to-self (raw):
- Keep email short. Laila likely cares about metrics and technical control (so highlight VPC option early).
- Avoid jargon about "LLM" in initial touch; use "search relevance" and "rerank overlay" to reduce pushback.
- Prioritize showing deterministic rollbacks and evaluation metrics.

Possible experimental tweaks for pilot (ideas to discuss on call):
- Try two rerank models: (A) small distilled transformer for latency, (B) hybrid BM25 + embedding blend. Run A/B at 20/80 to mitigate risk.
- Prefix caching for common nav queries to reduce cost and latency; precompute top-1 per selected query set.
- On-site assistant returns: limit scope to product recommendations and shipping FAQs, explicitly exclude payment flows initially.

End of notes.
summary: Outbound scratchpad for Quiver Retail pilot: call scripts, email drafts, integration checklist, objections & responses, pricing sketch, internal owners and next steps.
